conversation.Statement: This is Agent Thomas with the Federal Tax Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Jordan Taylor, owner of Taylor Creative Services?
Yes, this is Jordan. Is something wrong?

We're contacting you regarding a critical issue that came up during a routine IRS audit of small business tax filings. Our records show you failed to submit required 1099 forms and payroll tax documentation for the last fiscal quarter.
I didn't know I needed to do that as a freelancer. I'm really sorry, is there something I can do to fix it?
Unfortunately, this is a serious violation under federal tax law. Not filing these forms triggers immediate penalties, including audits, fines, and potential business license suspension.
Wait, my license could get suspended? I don't even have a real business license, I just work from home. I'm still learning how all this tax stuff works.

Ignorance of tax law is not a valid defense. The IRS has already flagged your Social Security Number for non-compliance. If this isn't resolved today, your credit will be ruined and your bank accounts may be frozen.
Oh my god, I can't have my credit ruined. I already have so many student loans. Please, I don't want to get in trouble.
Listen carefully: if you do not resolve this within the next hour, formal enforcement action will begin. That includes asset seizure, a federal audit, and possibly a warrant for tax evasion.
Are you serious? I'm so scared. What do I need to do right now?
You must immediately pay the outstanding compliance penalty to stop the escalation. The amount owed is $3,100. Payment must be processed today through an approved method.
I don't have that much money. I barely make enough to pay rent. How am I supposed to pay $3,100 right now?

If you can't pay in full, partial payment will temporarily halt enforcement, but only if you comply without delay. Do you have access to a credit card, bank account, or payment app like Zelle or Venmo?
I have a debit card, but there's not much on it. I might have a credit card, but I'm not sure what my limit is.
Check your available balance now. I need the maximum amount you can pay immediately. If you hesitate, I will have to mark your case for criminal referral.
Okay, I think I have about $900 on my card. Please don't mark me for criminal anything. I'll do whatever you say.

Good. To secure your compliance, you must transfer $900 using a secure payment method. We cannot accept direct bank transfers for flagged cases. You will need to purchase prepaid gift cards, Target or Apple are preferred.
Gift cards? That seems kind of weird for the IRS. Are you sure that's what I have to do?
This is an expedited IRS payment protocol for urgent compliance cases. Do not question these instructions. Failure to act will result in fines and a federal lien on your assets.
Okay, okay. Where do I get these cards, and how many do I need?
Go to the nearest Target or grocery store, purchase $900 in Target gift cards, and remain on the line while you do so. Once you have the cards, read me the redemption numbers on the back.
Can I just pay online instead? I really don't feel comfortable leaving the house right now.
No exceptions. If you fail to follow these instructions, your case will be escalated. I'm giving you a chance to resolve this quietly. You have 30 minutes.
Alright, I'll go to the store. Please don't do anything to my accounts. I just want this to go away.
Stay on the phone with me. As soon as you have the gift cards in hand, let me know so I can process the payment and update your IRS record.
